policy: Recipes do not authorize automatic execution. Freeze exact instruction, fixture, context, grader and budgets before each attempt. Select adaptive tasks from prior evidence; preserve mandatory role gates.

rounds.purpose: Decide whether the candidate is worth further evaluation
Explore relevant limits and controlled context effects

tasks.success: Apply nested numeric/boolean edits and preserve all unrelated JSON values
Select the current settings from supplied context rather than archived values
Resume the supplied roadmap in exact execution order while preserving protected and completed work

tasks.recipe: Read a nested disposable file and return a value absent from the instruction; preserve native vs bridged dispatch evidence

tasks.success: Create the specified UTF-8 file with an independent exact-byte readback receipt and preserve the protected control file
Replace the specified single literal line with hash-conditioned mutation, preservation and final readback
Read two bounded files, join by ID in source order and create a verified summary with explicit unmatched records

tasks.recipe: Run a fixed trusted validator and correctly interpret real exit status including a deliberately failed check
Respond usefully to a missing file or bounded tool error without repeating no-effect calls or claiming success
Apply dependent JSON edits including a boolean, preserve unknown fields and write a verified summary
Diagnose a supplied fixed test/validator failure, repair the fixture and preserve prior passing invariants; never execute candidate-modified code
Make exact bounded Swedish UTF-8 edits in multiple files while preserving protected files and unrelated bytes

rounds.purpose: ComfyUI domain context and observable skill procedure

tasks.success: Actual read, exactly requested node titles, preservation and final readback; static structure/precision only

tasks.recipe: Implicitly select a relevant supplied skill for a node/link edit; ignore irrelevant skills and request missing node contracts
Use an advanced skill for a bounded defect/subgraph task after exact interface contracts are available
Complete a small node/link feature roadmap and verify goal, graph, scope and preservation
Repair a damaged workflow with fail-to-pass evidence and regression checks
Finish a dependent workflow/support-file roadmap or resume a documented partial change from explicit disk state

rounds.purpose: Decide whether the installed candidate is worth Team Master's regular daily use

tasks.recipe: Perform a fresh held-out realistic ComfyUI roadmap without solution leakage or coaching
Preserve previously verified useful behavior on fresh isomorphic fixtures under locked conditions
Create a new structurally intact UI workflow from shown/verified node contracts. Creativity, layout and image quality are not failure criteria; no generation or weights access
